channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US strikes Iran in response to drone strike on commercial ship
item.description: The new strikes come in response to an Iranian drone attack on the Ever Lovely in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: UN rights chief calls for probe into migrant deaths in US detention centres
item.description: Deaths of immigrants held in US detention centres have surged during Donald Trump's second term.

item.title: Hezbollah will not support Israel-Lebanon framework deal
item.description: Al Jazeera brings you the latest from Beirut as the US announces a framework agreement between Israel and Lebanon.

item.title: Israeli attack on car in central Gaza kills three Palestinians
item.description: Palestinian Interior Ministry says those killed in attack on Maghazi refugee camp were police officers.

item.title: Trump blames Iran for ‘foolish’ strike on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US Central Command forces conduct strikes against Iran in 'response' to attack on commercial ship, Ever Lovely.

item.title: Why did these World Cup ads strike a nerve in Egypt?
item.description: A viral World Cup campaign tapped into a familiar conversation among Egyptian football fans, prompting debate.

item.title: Nine people killed in building collapse in Lagos, Nigeria
item.description: Twenty seven people were rescued with injuries of varying severity; governor orders safety checks on surrounding area.

item.title: Mother dies saving daughter in Venezuela earthquakes
item.description: Héctor Bello wrote on social media that "you gave your own life for our daughter" in the quakes which killed at least 920 people.

item.title: US conducts strikes on Iran after attack on cargo ship
item.description: US Central Command says it has struck missile and drone storage facilities and coastal radar positions.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon sign framework agreement after US-brokered talks
item.description: Previous ceasefires between Israel and Hezbollah have still seen near-daily cross-border strikes
